_comment: Copy to config.json (gitignored) and fill in. Not read automatically by any script — it's a place to keep the paths/keys you'd otherwise retype every project; paste the relevant values as CLI flags or env vars.
_sound_library_note: Usually the same folder as media_library_path (with sfx/ and music/ subfolders) — only set this to something different if SFX/music genuinely live elsewhere.
_style_profile_note: Use assets/style-profiles/honeymontana-creator-led.json instead for projects with an actual talking-head recording.
